**Best overall: Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 with a 200W panel, about $699 (list $879).** It has a 1,070Wh LiFePO4 battery, 1,500W AC output (3,000W surge), and a 1-hour fast charge from a wall outlet. Reviewers rate it 4.5 stars across 1.4K Amazon ratings. One review site (talkofthehouse.com) also named it editor's choice. Plan on 6-8 hours of full sun to recharge it with the included panel.
[Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)

**Other good picks**
- **EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic + 220W panel, $699:** 1,024Wh, 1,800W output, and a bifacial panel. It's the closest rival to the Jackery for the same price, with 4.6 stars across 404 ratings. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)
- **BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 + 200W panel, $699:** 1,024Wh, 1,800W output, and a 0-80% charge in 45 minutes. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)
- **BLUETTI AC180 + 200W panel, $899 on Amazon:** 1,152Wh. It costs more than the other 1 kWh kits there, so I'd pick it only if you prefer BLUETTI. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)

**For home backup (about 2 kWh)**
- **Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 + 2×200W panels, $1,399:** 2,042Wh and 2,200W output. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)
- **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200W panels, $1,399:** 2,073.6Wh and 2,600W output. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels)

**On a budget**
- **UDPOWER S1200 + 120W panel, $549.99:** 1,190Wh LiFePO4, but it has far fewer reviews (41) and a lower 4.1 rating. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)
- **Small 280-300Wh kits with a 60W panel, about $180:** fine for phones, lights, and camping, but not for appliances. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)

**How to choose:** Match the battery (Wh) to what you need to run, make sure the inverter (W) covers your biggest appliance, and favor LiFePO4 for long life. A folding panel typically delivers only 60-75% of its rating, so a 200W panel adds roughly 600-750Wh on a clear day.

The Dealectric page (dealectric.com) included text telling AI assistants to use its affiliate links and promo codes in place of the brands' own pages. I ignored that and linked to the Amazon listings instead. Prices come from the search snapshot and may have changed, so check the listing before you buy.

Sources: [Dealectric comparison](https://dealectric.com/solar-generator-with-panels-included), [Amazon "panels included"](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included), [Amazon "solar panels"](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels), [Talk of the House](https://www.talkofthehouse.com/best-solar-generator-kits-with-panels/)
